summary: Fail closed instead of stale Source evidence cache fallback on PostgreSQL read query failures.
diagnosis: PR 6320 introduced _fetch_records catching any exception and returning None, with read helpers falling back to private startup in-memory bootcache. When PostgreSQL connection or query failed, this silently served stale evidence from boot instead of failing closed, violating trustworthy evidence read guarantees and potentially masking database outages or serving outdated payloads.
fix: Remove silent bootcache fallback on Postgres read query failures in PostgresSourceEvidenceRepository (_read_one, _read_many, _read_by_dedupe). Raise sanitized RuntimeError('PostgreSQL evidence query failed: <ExceptionType>') from None to prevent DSN or secret exposure while ensuring all queries fail closed. API server returns 503 instead of 200 with stale cache when PostgreSQL fails.
